Annotators now need only a URL.

- **Annotator portal** (`annotator_app.py`): the safe, friendly face of the Wisdom Lab —
  judge pairs (✅ same idea / 🚫 different / ⏭️ skip), climb the leaderboard, watch your
  consistency score, and see the world map your judgments improve. No admin tabs,
  optional access code.
- **Deployment kit**: `Dockerfile` + `deploy/docker-compose.yml` (automatic HTTPS via
  Caddy, persistent database volume) + `deploy/DEPLOY.md` with hosting options and costs.
- **Windows fallback**: double-click `run_windows.bat` for local installs (`WINDOWS.md`).

Host it: see `deploy/DEPLOY.md`. Coordinate a study: seed the DB, share the URL + code.
